repos.name: FedericoTs/quantprobe
repos.description: Run a 110B on a 2016 PC with 16 GB RAM. Know your tok/s before you download. Placement beats budget: predicts speed + memory fit for any GGUF on your exact hardware, self-calibrates, emits the exact llama.cpp command — or 'quantprobe auto' does it all. Falsification-tested laws; misses published at full size. pip install quantprobe
repos.one_liner: A hardware-aware performance predictor for running large language models on constrained local hardware.
bullets: Built in Python, it uses hardware profiling to predict tokens-per-second and memory fit for GGUF models.
Solves the 'will it run' problem for quant-heavy local LLM deployments on aging or resource-limited hardware.
Features self-calibration logic to adjust predictions based on specific CPU/RAM configurations.
Essential for quant researchers and developers deploying local inference engines without enterprise-grade GPUs.

repos.name: opensible/opensible
repos.description: An open source GitOps control plane for OpenTofu & Ansible - provision, configure and deploy across cloud, on-prem and hybrid, self-hosted and forever free.
repos.one_liner: An open-source GitOps control plane designed to unify OpenTofu and Ansible workflows.
bullets: Provides a centralized control plane for infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and configuration management.
Supports hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premise environments through a unified GitOps pipeline.
Enables automated provisioning and deployment, reducing manual overhead in enterprise infrastructure management.
Offers a self-hosted, free alternative to proprietary infrastructure orchestration platforms.

repos.name: trycompai/crm
repos.description: Comp AI CRM is an open source, CRM designed for AI agents. Agentic-first CRM.
repos.one_liner: An agent-first, open-source CRM platform specifically engineered to integrate with autonomous AI agents.
bullets: Built with a TypeScript stack, focusing on structured data access for LLM-based automation.
Designed to act as a persistent memory and action layer for AI agents interacting with customer data.
Facilitates automated lead qualification, outreach, and data enrichment workflows.
Provides a modern API-first architecture for developers building autonomous sales and support systems.
